trigger_condition: Early blight includes 'target spot of tomato' despite distinct Alternaria/Corynespora agents.
guard_snippet: Keep both conditions; hold cross-condition alias in derivative resolver.
potential_consequence: Target Spot can retrieve Early blight advice.

trigger_condition: ToMV card includes TMV names.
guard_snippet: Verify separate identities; no automatic TMV alias for ToMV.
potential_consequence: Virus-specific identity, transmission and guidance get mixed.

trigger_condition: Fungal issue type/ID conflicts with oomycete pathogen type.
guard_snippet: Derived oomycete category with evidence; preserve raw disease ID.
potential_consequence: Incorrect biological lesson or category-dependent advice.

trigger_condition: Copper and 10% bleach appear outside chemical arrays.
guard_snippet: Apply claim-level chemical/concentration/context gates.
potential_consequence: Unverified chemical instructions bypass section-only filtering.

trigger_condition: Aphid advice despite empty vectors and mechanical transmission.
guard_snippet: Hold until virus/vector applicability is evidenced.
potential_consequence: User treats unrelated organism.

trigger_condition: Commercial mild-strain cross-protection appears in general guidance.
guard_snippet: Block practical MVP release; require specialist/context review.
potential_consequence: Home user could be advised to introduce virus.

trigger_condition: Overhead/misting and dry-foliage guidance conflict without context contract.
guard_snippet: Hold misting; no top-k merging; reviewed condition/context only.
potential_consequence: Mite intervention encourages another disease.

trigger_condition: Whole-plant health/no-disease claims exceed leaf classification.
guard_snippet: Limit result to leaf class; avoid whole-plant certification.
potential_consequence: False reassurance about infection or deficiency.

trigger_condition: Generic organizations/reviewer labels lack named actor or claim locator.
guard_snippet: Record URL/section/date/supported claim/limits; independent accountable reviewer.
potential_consequence: Generic attribution mistaken for real expert approval.

location: all cards#/review; knowledge-localization-edtech.md#Trạng thái review và phạm vi phát hành
trigger_condition: Pending/not_translated/false envelope differs from draft demo/public status vocabulary.
guard_snippet: Explicit status transitions and scope; source_checked never means expert_approved; no false-flag override.
potential_consequence: Consumers open advice under incompatible interpretations.

trigger_condition: 10 schema-draft links and unreviewed names are not identity/domain/translation approval.
guard_snippet: Separate image label, identity, domain claim and translation review states.
potential_consequence: Schema-valid or Vietnamese term mistaken for approved advice.

trigger_condition: 24/47 lookalike IDs unresolved; shorthand IDs differ from real IDs.
guard_snippet: Explicit old-ID/canonical-ID evidence decisions; unresolved stays blocked; no suffix fallback.
potential_consequence: Missing or wrong card appears in lesson/lookup.

trigger_condition: Model class order undefined; design has no executable manifest.
guard_snippet: Proposed ordered/versioned/hashed manifest; fixtures carry it; future checkpoint must verify it.
potential_consequence: Valid integer selects wrong disease.

trigger_condition: Target 1404 and mosaic 373 have zero resolved groups; label domain review absent.
guard_snippet: Keep mapping readiness separate from split/training readiness.
potential_consequence: Complete mapping falsely clears leakage/label blockers.

trigger_condition: Both leaf-curl concepts exist; only TYLCV has image class.
guard_snippet: Keep distinct conditions; no TLCV/leaf-curl alias merge.
potential_consequence: Symptom or different virus retrieves TYLCV care.

trigger_condition: Domain approval exists but VI is unreviewed.
guard_snippet: allow_display = domain_scope_allowed && translation_review == 'approved' && translation_source_hash == claim_source_hash
potential_consequence: Unreviewed or outdated VI becomes visible.

trigger_condition: Source changes while approval actor/date remains.
guard_snippet: if approval.content_sha256 != current_content_sha256: block('approval_stale')
potential_consequence: Approval for earlier claim reused for changed content.

trigger_condition: Only chemical array has applicability gate.
guard_snippet: classify_each_claim_by_content(); block_any_chemical_claim_without_local_applicability_review()
potential_consequence: Copper hydroxide bypasses review through biological array.

trigger_condition: Cultural array membership decides risk.
guard_snippet: if claim.contains_disinfectant_or_dose: require_specific_product_concentration_and_safety_review()
potential_consequence: Bleach concentration treated as ordinary sanitation.

trigger_condition: Two records share ID with different content.
guard_snippet: if len(record_ids) != len(set(record_ids)): reject_bundle('duplicate_knowledge_id')
potential_consequence: Silent overwrite or inconsistent advice.

trigger_condition: Healthy maps to reviewed disease card.
guard_snippet: if condition_id == 'TOM_HEALTHY': require(card.issue_type == 'healthy' && claim.kind == 'basic_care')
potential_consequence: Healthy result gives treatment despite valid review/version.
